QUOTE: `createPost` in `app/actions/remote/post.ts:74` writes the post to the local database before calling the server, under a `pending_post_id`. If `client.createPost` throws (lines 154–199), it: ... Rebuilds the post with `props.failed: true` and an updated `update_at`. Saves it to the database
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is written locally before the send and is kept and saved with `props.failed: true` on failure.
